description: Declarative image contract for redgate-lodge-bespoke. Every theme image is a slot here; the dashboard Page Images tab renders one upload/replace control per slot automatically, and components resolve them via themeImageCss/themeImageUrl. brand.images[<key>] overrides the theme default. Nothing is a hardcoded path.

slots.label: Home hero
slots.aiHint: wide forecourt or a single lead vehicle, calm premium tone

slots.label: About hero
slots.aiHint: the team, premises, or a signature vehicle

slots.label: Showroom exterior (Visit band)
slots.aiHint: the dealership building / forecourt from outside

slots.label: Services hero
slots.aiHint: service bay, MOT bay, or detailing

slots.label: Finance hero
slots.aiHint: handshake, signing, or a showroom desk

slots.label: Part Exchange hero
slots.aiHint: two cars side-by-side or keys being handed over

slots.label: Sell Your Car hero
slots.aiHint: owner stood next to their car / car-keys close-up

slots.label: Recently Sold hero
slots.aiHint: sold stamp, happy buyer, or a hero stock shot
